# Context

This fixture keeps a short narrative while loading the ticket body with inline validation requirements that must remain verbatim when rendered into the brief and the turn-one prompt.

## Validation

- `cargo test write_agent_brief_references_codebase_paths_without_linear_description --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test write_agent_brief_preserves_verbatim_inline_ticket_sections --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test render_agent_prompt_turn_one_avoids_full_description_duplication --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test render_issue_attachment_manifest_adds_prioritized_summary --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test render_agent_prompt_discussion_summary_is_newest_first_and_bounded --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test build_agent_instructions_renders_three_logical_blocks --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test render_continuation_prompt_is_compact --lib -- --exact`
- `cargo test listen_worker_codex_uses_continuation_prompt_on_resumed_turn --test listen -- --exact`
- `cargo test listen_worker_claude_uses_continuation_prompt_on_resumed_turn --test listen -- --exact`

## Test Plan

- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `make quality`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Validation bullets preserve order and text exactly
- [ ] Prompt remains under budget
- [ ] Brief remains under budget
